proposed.text: What is the first NSCP Section 420.7 rule for embedments in concrete?

options.text: Embedments may reduce fire protection if the contractor approves.
Embedments shall not significantly impair structural strength or reduce fire protection.
Embedments are checked only after occupancy.

rationale.correct: Section 420.7.1 states that embedments shall not significantly impair structural strength and shall not reduce fire protection.
rationale.takeaway: The first filter is structural and fire-protection impact.
